$comment: DeepSeek 'grinder' profile for Claude Code. Launch with:  claude --settings config/claude-deepseek-settings.json   — routes Claude Code through DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint instead of Anthropic. Use this ONLY for high-volume, low-reasoning grind (mass endpoint classification, first-pass JS skim). Keep exploitation, validation and severity calls on the default Claude profile.

env.$comment_model: DeepSeek's official Claude Code guide uses 'deepseek-v4-pro[1m]' as the main model and 'deepseek-chat' as the general alias. If a 'flash'/V4.1 identifier is live when you set this up, confirm the exact model string at https://api-docs.deepseek.com and drop it into ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Claude Code validates --model against an Anthropic allowlist, so set the model HERE via env, not with --model deepseek-...
env.$comment_key: Set ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (not ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) to avoid Claude Code's key-conflict prompt. Never commit the real key.
